text:
Anna L: Quick design q — current trace panel export button label is just 'Export'. For clarity in error analytics flows, I'd like 'Export traces' + show format (JSON / CSV) in the modal. Thoughts? cc @Devin R Devin R: Strong yes to explicit label. Accessibility: when modal opens focus should go to the format selector. Right now focus lands on the close X which is annoying for keyboard users. Micah P: Also +1. And the 'Copy' action for stack traces currently copies HTML from the viewer. Support pastes into tickets and the formatting breaks. We should make it copy plain text by default. Liz C: UX nit — prefer visible label 'Trace ID' instead of 'Correlation ID'. Users search for trace id. Tooltip: 'Unique identifier for this request/trace'. Keep it short. Anna L: So agreed: (1) button -> 'Export traces' (2) modal shows format dropdown and initial focus on it (3) copy action -> 'Copy stack trace' and copies plain text. Anything else? @a11y-bot any ARIA tips? a11y-bot: Recommend aria-live="polite" on export completion toast and role="status". Modal must trap focus and return focus to triggering element after close. Dropdown needs aria-label and arrow-key navigation. Tooltip should use aria-describedby. Devin R: Example success toast for implementation: ```html
Export complete — 42 traces. Download
``` Micah P: For server side ensure content-disposition header is set for downloads. Test call we use: `POST /api/traces/export { "format": "json", "filter": "error:true", "limit": 50 }` Anna L: Minor copy question: modal header 'Export traces' vs 'Export traces & spans' or 'Export traces (JSON/CSV)'. Thoughts? Liz C: Keep header short: 'Export traces'. Show format prominently in the modal — adding (JSON / CSV) in header feels noisy. Devin R: Placement q — should Export be in overflow menu or main toolbar? Support reaches for it often; burying it hurts workflow. Maybe put it next to 'Share' with an icon + text. Anna L: We can make it a toolbar item with a chevron and a tiny pill that shows last-used format, e.g. [Export traces ▾] [JSON]. Micah P: If we surface the pill, ensure color contrast meets WCAG. Make pill keyboard-focusable and SR announce format changes. a11y-bot: Contrast guidelines: interactive elements should meet 3:1 for UI components and 4.5:1 for text. Add visible focus ring. Anna L: Copy decisions: label for copy -> 'Copy stack trace'. Success toast -> 'Export complete — X traces exported. Download' (link). Consider adding 'View in logs' for support convenience. Devin R: Implementation note: client should call `getPlainStack()` instead of reading innerHTML/innerText. That will also run source-map mapping. I'll add keyboard test: open modal, change format, Enter, toast announced, focus returns to export button. Micah P: I'll open PR to set content-disposition and sanitize copied stacks (strip zero-width characters). ETA tomorrow. Also saw this error in logs during failed exports: `ERROR: export job failed: write /tmp/export-1234: permission denied` — modal should show friendly error copy: 'Export failed — try again or contact support.' Anna L: I'll update Figma: toolbar placement, export modal layout, and copy text. Also add tooltip copy and accessible flow. Liz C: Leave a short note in the spec: avoid 'correlation id' language; prefer 'Trace ID' for discoverability. Anna L: Next steps and owners: Anna — update Figma & copy; Devin — modal focus, aria-live; Micah — server headers & copy sanitize; Liz — final copy review; a11y-bot — verify ARIA once shipped. Target: EOD Wed for initial PRs. Devin R: One more test to add to QA: keyboard-only path — open modal, change format, press Enter, confirm announcement and focus return. Anna L: Thanks team — I'll create tasks on the trace-ux board and link PRs. Will post updates when PRs open. Micah P: FYI log snippet again: `ERROR: export job failed: write /tmp/export-1234: permission denied` — make error states show helpful next steps. Liz C: :+1 Anna L: Closing thread — will follow up when PRs ready. Thanks!
